::: {.callout-important}
## Midterm week

Week 7 is reserved for the **physical in-class midterm examination**.

There is no regular TRACE lesson, Colab activity, weekly quiz, lab evidence task, exit ticket, or homework submission this week.
:::

## Coverage

The examination covers the material developed in Weeks 1–6:

- problem solving, algorithms, and Input → Process → Output;
- executable Python statements and tracing;
- variables and data types;
- operators and expressions;
- input, output, and type conversion;
- comparisons and conditional logic;
- testing, debugging, and boundary reasoning.

## Preparation

Use the short review linked at the end of **Week 6**.

[Return to Week 6](week06.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}

The review material is for preparation only. The formal assessment takes place physically in class.

## After the examination

The course resumes in Week 8 with repetition and loops.
